selection: Curated dance/mood subset of open-vrma. Skipped AIST++ (source DB forbids redistribution), Motorica (no redistribution), pixiv/VRoid sample VRMA (no redistribution of motions), Mixamo (Adobe terms), 100STYLE and Bandai Namco Research (need BVH→VRMA conversion; Bandai is CC BY-NC 4.0 — noted for later personal-use conversion). Skipped franchise-named Mickey Dance, animal impersonations, and mis-tagged combat clips. Plus 47 extra CMU dance clips (modern, salsa, Indian, Charleston, breakdance, Russian) added 2026-11-11 from open-vrma; same licences. No Mixamo, AIST++, or VRoid Hub non-permissive models. Auto-update 2026-11-11: added 1 dance clips from open-vrma (same licence rules).
